rack: NIGHT DIAL, ELMSTEAD SIGNAL WORKS' hybrid voice (an example rack's faceplate)
coordinate_space: each view's own plate pixels at the house pitch; the host stacks the face and, while open, the deck below it, and scales the whole rack uniformly

rack_pitch.note: EIA: 19 in panel, 1.75 in per unit

face.conversion: closed.png's box from x 7 y 69 scaled by 0.9911996294580825 on both axes, then 586 scaled rows planned to 591

deck.conversion: open.png's deck from x 7 y 506 (the seam) scaled by 1.1674849972722312 on both axes, then 370 scaled rows planned to 394

bindings: each element binds its rack unit (an index into the design's units) and the unit module's local key; the host resolves the registry parameter per placed rack

face:plate.source: night-dial/skin-sources/plate-face.png with the sheet's knob bodies and the pull at rest baked in

deck:plate.source: night-dial/skin-sources/plate-deck.png's deck with the sheet's knob bodies and selector skirts baked in

face:deck.raised.role: the pull raised while the deck is open, over the clean housing that hides the pull at rest
face:deck.raised.motion: shown while the deck is open

face:backlight.lit.role: the dial glass lit warm amber, its printing glowing
face:backlight.lit.motion: shown while the unit is enabled

face:glow.rotor.role: the amber dot, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

face:knob.rotor.role: the amber dot, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

deck:knob.rotor.role: the amber dot, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

face:dial.rotor.role: the amber dot on its finger well's rim, stored at 12 o'clock about DIAL's pivot
face:dial.rotor.source: skin-sources/assets-01.png (dial-knob rotor): its dot and well cut apart at their narrowest row and placed as the concept's

deck:selector.bar.role: the black bar and its amber dot, stored at 12 o'clock about its middle
deck:selector.bar.motion: turns to each detent about the pivot

deck:lever.saw.role: the chrome lever up (SAW) on its plate, about the plate's centre

deck:lever.sqr.role: the chrome lever down (SQR) on its plate, about the plate's centre

face:needle.role: the amber-red needle, about its middle
face:needle.motion: moves along the dial's scale with DIAL's value

procedural:lock-dot.renderer: the stack's yellow lock dot at each element's geometry.dot

procedural:focus-ring.renderer: 2 px amber ring, 3 px outside the hit shape

procedural:tape.renderer: the house skin's tape blank and marker lettering, over geometry.tape while the printed legend is untrue
